summary: Sandbach United are just one week away from kicking off the 2026/27 season with an exciting new-look squad featuring fresh signings and a returning player. The Ramblers showed some good football in a recent match against St Helens, though they came up short, and the club is actively seeking sponsorship deals to support the campaign ahead. With three brand new kits and plenty of optimism around the squad, it's shaping up to be an interesting season as the team aims for promotion.
